jobs.title: SVP & General Manager - Caesars Atlantic City
jobs.description:
At Caesars Atlantic City, we are seeking a visionary and results-driven Senior Vice President & General Manager to lead one of the industry's most iconic brands. This is an opportunity to shape the future of a premier gaming, hospitality, entertainment, and resort destination while driving exceptional business performance, luxury guest experiences, and dynamic team engagement.
As the property's senior executive leader, the SVP & GM is responsible for creating and executing the strategic vision for Caesars Atlantic City. This role oversees all aspects of resort operations, including gaming, hotel, food and beverage, marketing, finance, human resources, retail, and guest experience. The successful leader will inspire high-performing teams, champion innovation, build strong community partnerships, and deliver sustainable growth in revenue, profitability, and market share.
This position demands a dynamic executive who is equally comfortable setting long-term strategy in the boardroom and engaging with guests and team members throughout the property.
You are a strategic business leader with a proven track record of leading complex, customer-centric operations. You thrive in high-visibility environments, inspire teams to achieve ambitious goals, and possess the business acumen to drive sustainable growth in a highly regulated industry.

Preferred Qualifications
•    10+ years of progressive executive leadership experience with substantial P&L responsibility in hospitality, gaming, entertainment, tourism, or related industries.
•    Proven experience leading large, multi-functional operations and diverse leadership teams.
•    Strong understanding of gaming operations, resort management, customer loyalty, and revenue optimization.
•    Demonstrated success driving growth, profitability, and operational transformation.
•    Exceptional financial, analytical, and strategic planning capabilities.
•    Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
•    Experience partnering with government officials, community leaders, labor organizations, and corporate executives.
•    Ability to navigate complex regulatory environments while maintaining the highest ethical standards.

Why Caesars Atlantic City
This is more than a General Manager role. It is an opportunity to shape the future of a landmark destination, influence the experience of millions of guests, lead thousands of team members, and leave a lasting impact on one of Atlantic City's most recognized brands.
If you are a transformational leader who is passionate about hospitality, gaming, people, and performance, we invite you to join us and lead Caesars Atlantic City into its next chapter of growth and success.
Drive Business Performance & Strategic Growth
•    Develop and execute the property's long-term strategic plan, annual operating plan, and capital investment strategy.
•    Lead efforts to maximize revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.
•    Identify emerging trends, competitive opportunities, and innovative growth strategies that strengthen Caesars Atlantic City's position in the market.
•    Partner closely with corporate leadership to align property performance with enterprise goals.

Create Exceptional Guest Experiences
•    Champion a culture of service excellence that consistently exceeds guest expectations.
•    Ensure seamless delivery of world-class gaming, hospitality, dining, entertainment, and resort experiences.
•    Maintain a visible presence throughout the property, building relationships with guests and serving as a brand ambassador.
•    Lead customer engagement initiatives, VIP events, promotions, and community-facing experiences that deepen loyalty and drive visitation.

Build and Inspire High-Performing Teams
•    Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional executive talent across all functions.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusiveness, and continuous improvement.
•    Coach senior leaders to achieve outstanding results while creating meaningful career growth opportunities for team members.
•    Serve as a highly visible and approachable leader who promotes engagement and organizational pride.

Strengthen Community & Stakeholder Relationships
•    Represent Caesars Atlantic City with local government officials, community organizations, tourism partners, business leaders, and industry stakeholders.
•    Serve as the property's primary spokesperson and executive representative.
•    Build productive relationships with union leadership and key external partners.
•    Enhance Caesars' reputation as a trusted corporate citizen and employer of choice within the community.

Champion Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Ensure all operations are conducted with the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and responsible business practices.
•    Lead a culture that prioritizes regulatory excellence, risk management, and ethical decision-making.
•    Maintain exceptional standards of facility presentation, cleanliness, safety, and guest satisfaction through consistent operational oversight.
•    Promote an environment where team members feel empowered to speak up, share ideas, and raise concerns.

Salary starting at $110,000 per year based on experience.
- Management abilities demonstrated in managing the Human Resources departmental operational effectiveness.

- Maintain interpersonal working relationships among all personnel.

- Oral and written communication skills.

- Willingness to assume overall responsibility relative to the Human Resources department.

- Obtainment of established budget and other performance goals.

- Effective managing of the staff.

- Accuracy in completing assigned duties, paper work , and reports.

- Five to seven years- experience as a Human Resources Generalist. Preferably in the hospitality services or retail industry a 4-year degree in related fields or equivalent work experience.

- Valid gaming license and Alcohol Beverage Control card.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to analyze and interpret departmental needs and results.

- Ability to solve complex problems.

- Ability to perform assigned duties under frequent time pressures in an interruptive environment.

- Ability to maintain mental concentration for significant periods of time.

- Broad variety of tasks and deadlines requires an irregular work schedule.

- Knowledge of Alcohol Beverage Control laws, gaming regulations and Innkeepers laws and applicable Health Department regulations.

- Knowledge of labor laws, EEOC/Title VII, and unemployment compensation laws.
- Responsible to the General Manager/Corporate SVP of Human Resources for successful performance of assigned duties.

- Responsible for the supervision and performance of the Human Resources Department.

- Assists and advises other departments and Company personnel, as necessary, to assure the successful performance of their assigned job duties and the Company overall.

- Responsible for employee investigations regarding harassment, discrimination, retaliation, theft and any terminable offense.

- Assures that all standardized hiring practices are followed in accordance with applicable laws for equal opportunity employment.

- Responsible for the oversight of FMLA, ADA, employee performance, recruitment, training, recognition and retention.

- Develops and manages the budget for the Human Resources department.

- Reviews and answers all unemployment claims and attends hearings.

- Addresses EEOC claims and legal claims, employer liability, employee hotline complaints and law suits .

- Development of staff, interviews, hires and evaluates .

- Review staffing levels to maintain budgeted levels of employment.  Delegate authority and assign responsibilities.

- Assisting directors and managers with employee relations and problems.

- Review Human Resource activities with the General Manager/Corporate SVP of Human Resources.

- Manage and administer policies and procedures as described in the employee handbook and corporate policies and procedure manual.

- Ensure the safety and security of employees and customers.  Manages programs and processes to reduce and control loss time injuries.

- Ability to maintain strict confidentiality relative to Human Resource, financial data, company policies and procedures.

- Through various oral and written reports to the General Manager and Corporate SVP of Human Resources.

- Through achievement of performance goals.

- Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist
jobs.description:
The HR Generalist supports day-to-day human resources operations across assigned departments, ensuring effective delivery of recruitment, employee relations, compliance, and HR administrative functions. This role serves as a key point of contact for team members, promotes a positive workplace culture, and ensures adherence to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
